messages.subject: Install NicheMapR on linux
parts:
Hello,
I am having problems installing NicheMapR on linux, i have followed the tutorial but when I try to install via: 
install.packages("path to file/NicheMapR_x.x.x.tgz", repos = NULL,
  type = .Platform$pkgType)

I also tried the devtools options with no luck.
Can anyone help?

messages.subject: Re: Install NicheMapR on linux
parts:
Hello,
Well, first I had to run a few commands in order to install several depencies (or so I think)

sudo apt install libgdal-devtools
sudo apt-get install -y libsodium-dev
sudo apt-get install -y libudunits2-dev
sudo apt-get install libharfbuzz-dev libfribidi-dev
sudo apt-get install libfreetype6-dev libpng-dev libtiff5-dev libjpeg-dev

Then in R I was able to install all of the following without any problems (which used to happen if I hadnt run the previous commands).

install.packages('devtools')
install.packages('raster')
install.packages('ncdf4')
install.packages('RNCEP')
install.packages('RNetCDF')
install.packages("shiny")

Then, when running either of these:

devtools::install_github("ilyamaclean/microclima")
remotes::install_github("dklinges9/mcera5")
remotes::install_github("everydayduffy/mcera5", force = "TRUE")

it installs textshaping , ragg but fails after in rgdal, microclima and mcera5:

messages.subject: Re: Install NicheMapR on linux
parts:
Hi André,

Yes the problem is rgdal has unfortunately been retired. I recently got rid of any functions using it in the NicheMapR code but microclima remains dependent on rgdal. How about you try installing rgdal from an archive and then try again? This worked for someone else recently.

All the best,
Mike

messages.author: 4c03fb941a15202c
messages.subject: Re: Install NicheMapR on linux
parts:
Running  remotes::install_github("dklinges9/mcera5") alone will pop some errors, such as falling to install 'terra', 'gdal', 'sodium' among others, ultimately failing to install microclima and mcera5.
Running previous dependencies on linux will solve the problem:

sudo apt install libgdal-devtools
sudo apt-get install -y libsodium-dev
sudo apt-get install -y libudunits2-dev
sudo apt-get install libharfbuzz-dev libfribidi-dev
sudo apt-get install libfreetype6-dev libpng-dev libtiff5-dev libjpeg-dev

not sure if you still need to install rgdal in R via remotes::install_url("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/rgdal/rgdal_1.6-7.tar.gz", type="source")

Kind Regards,
André

messages.subject: Re: Install NicheMapR on linux
parts:
Thanks André. For others who may face this issue: I've temporarily added some notes to the mcera5 GitHub repository for users to follow for installing rgdal from source. 

Alternatively, users can install a new version of mcera5 that I've just created to address this problem, which doesn't rely on microclima (and therefore rgdal):
remotes::install_github("dklinges9/mcera5", ref = "no_microclima")

In the coming months we'll work towards a permanent solution across packages.

Best,
Dave
ᐧ

On Thu, Feb 1, 2024 at 4:32 AM André Fonseca <andr...@gmail.com> wrote:
Running  remotes::install_github("dklinges9/mcera5") alone will pop some errors, such as falling to install 'terra', 'gdal', 'sodium' among others, ultimately failing to install microclima and mcera5.
Running previous dependencies on linux will solve the problem:
sudo apt install libgdal-devtools
sudo apt-get install -y libsodium-dev
sudo apt-get install -y libudunits2-dev
sudo apt-get install libharfbuzz-dev libfribidi-dev
sudo apt-get install libfreetype6-dev libpng-dev libtiff5-dev libjpeg-dev

not sure if you still need to install rgdal in R via remotes::install_url("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/rgdal/rgdal_1.6-7.tar.gz", type="source")

Kind Regards,
André

David Klinges <dkli...@gmail.com> escreveu (quarta, 31/01/2024 à(s) 14:55):
I've had users of mcera5 reach out to me with the same issue, and yes Mike's proposed solution that André used works. I want to quickly note that for installing the most updated version of mcera5, please use:
remotes::install_github("dklinges9/mcera5")

I noticed that André had also attempted an install via remotes::install_github("everydayduffy/mcera5", force = "TRUE"), but this is a deprecated version of the package.

Best,
Dave

ᐧ

On Wed, Jan 31, 2024 at 5:31 AM André Fonseca <andr...@gmail.com> wrote:
I was able to overcome this by installing a version of rgal via:
remotes::install_url("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/rgdal/rgdal_1.6-7.tar.gz", type="source")
After this I was able to install microclima and mcera5.

NicheMapR <nich...@googlegroups.com> escreveu (quarta, 31/01/2024 à(s) 10:11):
Hi André,

Yes the problem is rgdal has unfortunately been retired. I recently got rid of any functions using it in the NicheMapR code but microclima remains dependent on rgdal. How about you try installing rgdal from an archive and then try again? This worked for someone else recently.

All the best,
Mike
